indicator_period_rule: full-year rows when the file has them, otherwise the label it uses most
population_period: На 1 января (the only label the population file carries)
wage_note: wage is reported per OKVED2 sector; the territory value is the headcount-weighted mean over sectors, so a municipality reporting wages only for some sectors gets a partial-sector value rather than a fabricated one
